title: OTHRYS OS local project registry shell
goal: Make New Project functional as controller-local project metadata without filesystem, git, Factory or execution authority.
laws: Project drafts live in controller-local browser storage only.
Creating a project does not create directories, repositories or Oroi.
No filesystem, git, Factory, shell or model endpoint is added.
Canonical othrys-v2 remains separately visible and immutable from this control.
Project names are bounded and plain text only.
Deleting local project metadata changes no machine state.
Promotion into a real Oros remains a later explicit mission.
